cases.name: agent_asks_wins
cases.description: 一个 Agent 在问用户：不管别的 Agent 在跑，都是「等你」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an agent asking is Waiting on you, whatever else holds

cases.name: owner_decides_needs_user
cases.description: review 说 needs_user：等你拍板。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a decision for the owner is Waiting on you

cases.name: owner_decides_ask
cases.description: ask 是一个决定：等你拍板。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a decision for the owner is Waiting on you

cases.name: please_verify_is_just_finished
cases.description: 已部署的「请验证」由主管验收，在「刚做完」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a deployed to-do's Please verify, or a done conclusion, is Just finished: the supervisor accepts it, not the owner

cases.name: done_ask_is_just_finished
cases.description: 结论是做完了：在「刚做完」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a deployed to-do's Please verify, or a done conclusion, is Just finished: the supervisor accepts it, not the owner

cases.name: running_on_old_todo
cases.description: Agent 在跑：「在做」，再老的待办也是。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an agent running is Working, even on an old to-do

cases.name: closed_recently
cases.description: 关掉 24 小时内：「刚做完」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a closed to-do is Just finished for a day, then Done

cases.name: closed_long_ago
cases.description: 关掉超过 24 小时：「已完成」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a closed to-do is Just finished for a day, then Done

cases.name: accepted_reopened
cases.description: 验收后被 hub 重开（又派了活）：仍是已验收、刚做完。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an accepted task reopened by more work is finished, not Follow up

cases.name: accepted_running_again
cases.description: 已验收的任务 Agent 又在跑：「在做」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an accepted task whose agent runs again is Working

cases.name: deployed
cases.description: 交付已上线：刚做完。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a deployed delivery is finished

cases.name: finished_unseen
cases.description: Agent 做完一轮没人看：刚做完。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a finished turn nobody saw is Just finished

cases.name: pr_delivery_old
cases.description: 交付停在 PR：不管多老都在「待合并」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an open PR is PR to merge however old, a merged one is not

cases.name: pr_url_old
cases.description: 只有 pr_url、没有交付状态：待合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an open PR is PR to merge however old, a merged one is not

cases.name: pr_merged_old
cases.description: PR 已合并没部署、48 小时没动：搁置。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > an open PR is PR to merge however old, a merged one is not

cases.description: 阶段到了 merge：PR 已合并，不算待合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.name: pr_stage_deploy
cases.description: 阶段到了 deploy：PR 已合并，不算待合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.name: pr_stage_verify
cases.description: 阶段到了 verify：PR 已合并，不算待合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.name: pr_stage_review
cases.description: 阶段在 review：PR 还开着，待合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.name: merged_not_deployed
cases.description: 合并了没部署：其他进行中。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.name: merged_and_deployed
cases.description: 合并并部署：刚做完。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a PR the stage says is merged is not PR to merge, whatever the delivery (#3205)

cases.description: 任务 48 小时没动：搁置。

cases.name: agent_moved_recently
cases.description: Agent 最近动过：不搁置。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a task with no move for 48 hours is Shelved; a newer move of its agent keeps it

cases.description: 用户自己的待办（没 Agent、没来源）：不自动搁置。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > the user's own to-do without agents never shelves itself, nor one due ahead

cases.name: due_ahead_never_shelves
cases.description: 截止日在后面：不搁置。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > the user's own to-do without agents never shelves itself, nor one due ahead

cases.name: restore_counts_as_move
cases.description: 一小时前恢复：算动过。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a restore counts as a move

cases.name: restore_too_old
cases.description: 恢复超过 48 小时：又搁置。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a restore counts as a move

cases.name: last_activity_latest
cases.description: 最后活动取待办、监督和 Agent 里最晚的。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > last activity takes the latest of the to-do, its supervision and its agents

cases.description: 看过之后才关掉：关掉是新动静，还在「刚做完」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a seen to-do goes to Done at once; one seen before it got there stays

cases.name: accepted_seen
cases.description: 验收之后看过：「已完成」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a seen to-do goes to Done at once; one seen before it got there stays

cases.name: deployed_seen
cases.description: 上线之后看过：「已完成」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a seen to-do goes to Done at once; one seen before it got there stays

cases.description: 看过之后又有动静：回到「刚做完」。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a finished turn seen since it last moved is Done, unless its PR is open

cases.description: 看过了，但 PR 还开着：「PR 待合并」，等用户合并。
cases.from_test: web/src/lib/todo-triage.test.ts > a finished turn seen since it last moved is Done, unless its PR is open
